Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made an error by providing incorrect capacity information (79,451) in Step 4, inferred from unclear or unreliable search snippet data, without cross-verifying against authoritative sources. The visible snippet in Step 4 indicated 79,451 but also mentioned 76,416, yet WebSurfer did not resolve the discrepancy. This resulted in conflicting figures and set off a chain of repetitive searches, misinterpretations, and redundant instructions in subsequent steps. A lack of proper validation of search results before reporting back to the Planner was the root cause.
